integrity: An analytical proof is provided. Bounded diagnostic tests supplement but do not certify the universal theorem. Novelty comparison does not establish complete publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Exact for unweighted crown graphs, distance exponent one, unrestricted metric targets and real L1 targets; no higher-power, complex-valued L1 or irregular-family classification. Independent audit not performed.
title: Sharp metric and real \(L^1\) Poincaré constants of crown graphs
